# Prediction Bot

A self-contained, offline-capable page with PredictionBot's model picks for **tennis, UFC, soccer, golf and NASCAR
Cup** — the same tabs as the Windows app: Best 5 by sport, every value pick, Record (over/under and yes/no splits,
Explore breakdowns), Model (calibration charts, log loss vs the market per sport), NASCAR (status and ratings) and
pick history.

* `index.html` is generated by `PredictionBot export-site` (PredictionBot 2.7.1, sportsodds scraper library 2.2.7,
  schema v9; data as of Sat Oct 31, 2026 10:07 PM EDT) and contains only the published model output: the model's record, calibration and
  aggregates, and — once the closing-line-value gate has passed — picks with best price and book, fair (no-vig)
  price, edge, stake in units and line moves. No code internals, database, file paths or credentials live here.
* **Picks are private until their closing-line value is proven positive** (at least 20 closes, positive mean).
  Until then the tamper-proof pick log is published as hash-only commitments (line number, previous hash, hash);
  the salted entries behind them are released when the gate opens. Shadow sports are never shown.
* Filters can be linked via the URL hash, e.g. `#t=tennis&d=2026-10-27&c=Medium&q=sinner` (tab, date, minimum
  tier, search).
* **My bets and bankroll** are stored only in your browser's localStorage, never uploaded. Record → My bets
  exports/imports a JSON file in the same format as the Windows app (Record → My bets → Export / Import), so bets
  move between the PC and a phone or tablet.
* Families marked **SHADOW** (all NASCAR markets while they are in shadow mode) are priced and logged for
  evaluation only and are never suggested as picks.
* For information only — a statistical model, not a guarantee. Lines move; re-check before betting. 21+.
  Problem gambling help: 1-800-GAMBLER.
